settings.title: Training reminders
settings.subtitle: A nudge before each planned session, so the plan does not quietly drift.
settings.nonePlanned: No reminder scheduled yet. Build a plan and the next session will be queued.
settings.denied: Notifications are turned off for this app. Enable them in your device settings, then flip this back on.

disclosure.title: Training reminders
disclosure.intro: Running Coach can send you a <bold>reminder before each planned session</bold>.
disclosure.bullet1: Reminders are scheduled <bold>on this device only</bold>. Nothing about your training is sent anywhere.
disclosure.bullet2: They follow your plan: complete or skip a session and its reminder disappears.
disclosure.bullet3: You can turn them off at any time in Settings, or from your device's notification settings.
